## [1.5.1](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1) (2026-11-26)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* disable streamer highlights and chat navigation by default ([49b887e](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/49b887e83f9178ecbe9999e71d999ee5b7084005))
* preserve exception handlers when removing playback ads ([f79104f](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/f79104f2468076027c9f060cfdd046174f8e6f59))
* restore complete CHZZK 3.18.0 mobile patch support ([7c6cfde](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/7c6cfde6be05b8d57f8c809d1aedd33dc35ccb00))
* restore startup on CHZZK 3.18.0 and TV 1.5.0 ([c377fad](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/c377fad4f3c9723a89119e570fbe6b25798d5065))

### ✨ New Features

* add streamer chat highlighting and chat navigation ([771af36](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/771af366626b6bc3a2f1866bac31380cdb2d8203))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support all patches on CHZZK for Android TV 1.5.0 ([4fe32b2](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/4fe32b2f75256db1d39f7df78ad74155eb689a1e))

patches.name: Auto claim TongPow
patches.description: Claims watch-time TongPow through the app's claim button handler. Can be disabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: CDN playback
patches.description: Creates player configurations with peer-assisted streaming disabled.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside the original app using a separate package name and app data.

options.description: 원본과 함께 설치할 앱의 고유 이름입니다. 업데이트할 때도 같은 값을 사용하세요.

patches.name: Chat customization
patches.description: Adds in-player Morphe settings, draggable chat width, chat styling, individual badge controls, device icons, streamer highlighting, chat jump buttons, chat input buttons, live viewer count, live rewind and catch-up, audio compression and volume boost, player button visibility, recent chat and settings copy/paste.

patches.name: Custom app branding
patches.description: Changes the app name shown by Android. Defaults to 치지직 S.

options.description: 홈 화면과 Android 앱 목록에 표시할 이름입니다.

patches.name: Home without promotions
patches.description: Removes home carousels, campaign exposure and promotional topic rows while preserving content rows.

patches.name: Playback without ads
patches.description: Skips player ad-source wrapping, ignores live ad events and removes AD cards from the clip feed.
